title: MIMO FIR Filter
text: Filter input signals through multipath MIMO FIR filter, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Numerator} sets Time-domain FIR filter coefficients [ 0.5 0.5; {Numerator source} sets the source of FIR filter, {Number of propagation paths}, {Sum filtered output contributions from all input channels} sets the option to sum filtered output contributions from all input, {View Filter Response} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Num
ports.summary: Time-domain FIR filter coefficients row vector | matrix

params.name: Numerator source
params.values: Source of FIR filter coefficients Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Numerator
params.values: Time-domain FIR filter coefficients [ 0.5 0.5; 0.75 0.25 ] (default) | row vector | matrix

params.name: Number of propagation paths
params.values: Number of propagation paths between each input and output channel pair 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Sum filtered output contributions from all input channels
params.values: Option to sum filtered output contributions from all input channels on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
